entities.name: Tabala Fortress
entities.description: Ziggurat-like keep on a plateau in the Flowstone desert, built by prisoners, half a world from the Stronghold of Rath.

entities.name: Stronghold of Rath
entities.description: Reference point half a world from Tabala.

events.summary: A forgotten evincar commanded the flowstone to level the plateau, and later gangs of prisoners built the fort.
events.quote: Later, gangs of prisoners sweltered by darkness and daylight to erect the fort
